question:
Which two numbers need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

24 + 22 × 12 ÷ 16 – 8 = 32
solution:
BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/R00lFKLUqDGYHQdFm3PUxJQIiZjv93sySTJwkdUMUX62dFwYGrJkelyhMX_mJ7U_6t_cKD5SrMA9PS3Vze4G6_7tDUT1ZpVsCQqriDEF0g2NPHToxU1SuYruPB1RciSu9evX6xjt-ktvleHqlzrEsA] 

Option 1) 22 and 24

Interchanging the number we get;

⇒ 22 + 24 × __**12 ÷ 16**__ - 8 = 32

⇒ 22 + __**24 × 0.75**__ - 8 = 32

⇒ __**22 + 18**__ - 8 = 32</span&
